title: _events_rx drop in main.rs needs an explanatory comment
description: main.rs line 57: let (events_tx, _events_rx) = make_channel(64); The initial receiver is immediately dropped. The underscore prefix suppresses the compiler warning but not the reader confusion. A future maintainer will ask: 'Is this a bug? Should something be reading this channel?' The actual answer is: EventSource handlers call tx.subscribe() to create their own receivers on demand (broadcast channel pattern). Without a comment, this will be re-investigated on every future code reading. Fix: add a one-line comment: '// Receiver is dropped here; EventSource handlers call tx.subscribe() per connection.'.
